_comment: 2D box, S8 (40 ordinates) with reflective left + bottom faces. S8 is the first order whose level-symmetric weights are NOT all equal - three distinct values across the permutation classes - so this is what puts unequal weights through a real solve: the angular integral, the reflection maps and the reflect partner columns all see them. A coarse 20x20 grid on purpose, since none of that is about resolution. The vacuum faces carry the 4 pi inflow that makes their per-ordinate incoming flux 1.0, matching box_30_s4_reflect_lb.json so the two differ only in the quadrature order.
